doc: The match's colour grade on the desktop renderer (Look.environment 'desktop_boost'). desktop_saturation_boost multiplies the base grade's saturation (1.14): it was 1.65 (net 1.88), which drew Hunters at a median saturation of 0.49 at the match camera against the target 0.21 (the clear evening multiplies it by 0.8 more, RaidLook). 0.75 (net 0.68 in a clear evening) measured 0.24 on the 13 Hunters, with every Hunter's hue kept (tools/hunter_grade_shots.gd, docs/art/HUNTER_GRADE.md). Set it to 1.65 to put the old grade back. Raid conditions (RaidLook) multiply on top of it.
